newsitem.title: USA: Venture Stores May same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Venture Stores May same-store sales off.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said Friday that same-store sales for the four weeks ended May 24 were off 15.1 percent.
Total sales for the month were $93.9 million, down 11.3 percent from $106 million in the year-ago period.
For the 17 weeks ending May 24, total sales were $408.4 million compared with $457.2 million in the year-ago period. Same-store sales for the period were down 12 percent.

"We believe that our strategy to reposition Venture as a family value retailer is sound, but it will take some time to rebuild the momentum we had gained at the beginning of 1997," said Venture chief executive Robert Wildrick.

"Although the new credit facility Venture obtained in April has had a positive impact on merchandise flow, May sales continue to show the effects of disruptions in shipments in certain areas," he said.
Venture operates 113 stores in nine states.
